I hope you have enjoyed your ride with Calamari Shuttles &mdash;|Ex-Eighty-Nine's autopilot|<ref name="Death in the Undercity">''[[Death in the Undercity]]''</ref>}}
'''Ex-Eighty-Nine''' was a [[Autopilot/Legends|automated]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] belonging to [[Calamari Shuttles]]. Due to an [[Autopilot/Legends|autopilot]] malfunction, it crashed on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] with a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives on board.
